title: Ariyo
text: 2. Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāya || katame satta || || Satisambojjhaṅgo || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyāti || ||
